claims.hypothesis: Is there a compact galaxy group at z~4.3 around two optically/NIR dark ALMA-detected galaxies?
claims.experiment: ALMA 3 mm line scans for spectroscopic redshifts, COSMOS2020 photometric-redshift selection of candidates, and overdensity analysis
claims.result: Two spectroscopic members at z=4.331 and 4.324, 11 candidate members, 13 galaxies over 13x31 arcsec, overdensity delta_OD=2.16 (3 sigma)
claims.finding: CGG-z4 is a compact galaxy group in an overdense environment

evidence.quote: CCG-z4 contains two optically/NIR dark galaxies with spectroscopic redshifts at $z=4.3$ and 11 optical/NIR-detected candidate members

claims.hypothesis: Do the optical/NIR-detected members contribute significantly to the CO emission and SFR of the group?
claims.experiment: Stacking of spectra at candidate member positions at the redshift of CGG-z4.a
claims.result: No definitive 2 sigma detections of CO(5-4) or CO(4-3), nor continuum
claims.finding: The two dark galaxies dominate the group SFR and gas content

evidence.quote: This indicates that the two optically dark galaxies dominate the total SFR and gas content of this group.

claims.hypothesis: Are the dark galaxies gas-rich, efficient starbursts?
claims.experiment: Gas masses from dust continuum (thin/thick), CO(4-3), and [CI](1-0), combined with IR SFRs
claims.result: log Mgas ~ 10.3-11.3 depending on method; gas depletion times about 23-140 Myr (~100 Myr typical)
claims.finding: Starburst galaxies with large gas reservoirs, massive stellar masses and short depletion times

evidence.quote: Using dust continuum, CO, and CI lines as gas tracers, we found CGG-z4.a and CGG-z4.b are starburst galaxies with large amount of gas reservoirs

claims.hypothesis: What do the line ratios say about the ISM conditions?
claims.experiment: Compare CO(5-4)/CO(4-3) and [CI]/CO(4-3) with literature samples and PDR modelling
claims.result: r54 near the 1.56 thermalization value; r_CI43 among the lowest in the reference sample
claims.finding: High ISM excitation and efficient star formation

evidence.quote: We compared the line ratios of CGG-z4.a and CGG-z4.b with literature sample and found the ratio $\rm r_{54}$ is close to the thermalization, while $\rm r_{CI43}$ is among the lowest values compared to galaxies from the literature

claims.hypothesis: Will the dark galaxies quench soon?
claims.experiment: Extrapolate with constant SFE and the current gas reservoirs, no replenishment
claims.result: Final stellar masses ~1e11 Msun; time z=4.33 to 4.0 is ~140 Myr
claims.finding: They may become quiescent at z~4.0, as in other overdense structures

evidence.quote: it is possible that they will become quiescent at $z\sim4.0$

claims.hypothesis: Will CGG-z4 grow into a cluster with the dark galaxies as BCGs?
claims.experiment: Five halo mass methods and comparison with merger-tree curves and TNG300 proto-BCGs
claims.result: log Mdm = 12.8 +/- 0.4; BCG progenitor stellar mass expectation 10.5 consistent with the galaxies
claims.finding: CGG-z4 is a forming protocluster likely to reach >1e14 Msun by z~0

evidence.quote: Comparisons with the simulations suggest that CGG-z4 is a forming protocluster, which is likely to form a cluster with $\rm M>10^{14}\, M_\odot$ by $z\sim0$

why_this_data.value: FIR SED suggested z_FIR~6 for CGG-z4.a, so a 3 mm line scan was requested to confirm the redshift

evidence.quote: Our initial FIR SED analysis with deblended FIR photometry suggested a $z_{\rm FIR}\sim6$; this was followed up with an ALMA 3mm line scan

why_this_method.value: Bagpipes chosen over EAZY for physical properties of individual galaxies

evidence.quote: EAZY primarily excels in determining the redshift probability distribution of large galaxy samples. Other SED fitting codes are more suited when estimating the physical properties of individual galaxies.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Exponential SFH in Bagpipes gave virtually identical results to constant SFH

evidence.quote: We note that we tried using an exponential SFH, which resulted in virtually identical results

limitations_admitted.value: Stellar masses of the dark galaxies are uncertain because based on one-band IRAC photometry

evidence.quote: A caveat is that the inferred stellar masses are prone to be uncertain as they are based on one-band photometry.

limitations_admitted.value: Unaccounted systematic error from assuming r41 = 1.0

evidence.quote: We note that there is a systematic error in using a value of r$_{\rm L^{\prime}41}=1.0$ that is unaccounted for.

limitations_admitted.value: CO(1-0) observations needed to constrain gas masses better

evidence.quote: To constrain the estimates of M$_{\rm gas}$ better, observations of the $115\,\rm GHz$ CO(1-0) line are needed.

referee_caveats_inferred: Gas mass spread across methods is up to ~0.8 dex; the headline depletion time of ~100 Myr depends on which alpha is chosen
Gas fractions rely on stellar masses from one IRAC band and an assumed M*/Mdust ratio
Individual-source FIR properties are obtained by scaling a combined SED, so individual dust temperatures and SFRs are not independently fit
The text names project 2021.1.00246.S twice in the SPW count, so the data description has a typo
Heavy reliance on earlier papers for pipeline and halo mass method limits stand-alone reproduction

missing_for_reproduction: Calibration details, line-free channel ranges and uv_fit parameters
MICHI2 and Bagpipes setup beyond parameter ranges
Per-source Super-deblended photometry and stellar mass distributions for the Monte Carlo
Halo-mass method details held in Sillassen et al. 2024
No statement that data or code are public
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Roughly 10-50 GB of raw ALMA data for three short projects (26 min, 3x20 min, 0.7 min)
reproducibility.score_reason: Scale 1-5. Many numeric results with tables, but pipeline is inherited from earlier papers and key uv_fit, SED and halo-mass settings are not given.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public status of the data is not stated and the recipe depends on unstated settings and earlier-paper pipelines.
